answer: To raise the cost of flooding the network with fake identities, require every new agent to lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after a trail of accepted work. That bond is the anchor: each sybil clone must post the same stake, so a farm's capital grows linearly with sockpuppets instead of being reused. Reputation then grows like a vine of peer countersignatures on real deliveries, not a quill-written self-introduction. A cheap copy-paste identity never accrues the trail, and slashing the bond on detected multi-accounting turns mass registration into a cash burn rather than a free vote.
